headline: Rojas' 10th-inning single walks off Pirates
recap: Johan Rojas singled to center with one out in the bottom of the 10th, scoring Cristian Pache — who had started the inning on second base — for a 3-2 walk-off win over the Pittsburgh Pirates. The run was unearned, charged to reliever David Bednar (3-3), who had struck out the first batter he faced before allowing the game-ending hit.

Aaron Nola struck out eight over 6 2/3 innings for Philadelphia, allowing one earned run on Bryan Reynolds' leadoff homer in the seventh. Pittsburgh starter Mitch Keller went six innings and allowed two runs — Brandon Marsh's solo homer and a Bryce Harper sacrifice fly, both in the sixth — while striking out six.

Craig Kimbrel blew his fifth save of the season when Henry Davis homered with one out in the eighth to tie the game at 2-2. Jeff Hoffman then worked a scoreless 10th, stranding Jack Suwinski — who had started the inning on second base — at third, to earn his fifth win of the year.
